segment_captions.caption: A beekeeper wearing protective gear inspects a wooden hive frame filled with bees. The hive has a logo of a bee and the text 'HONEYLOVE.org' engraved on it.
A close-up of a jar filled with honey, with a white lid and a small bee inside the jar. The text 'THIS' appears in the top left corner of the frame.
A honey dipper is submerged into a jar of honey, lifting out a portion.
A honey dipper scoops honey from a jar. The scene shifts to a man sitting outdoors near a barbecue grill, wearing a t-shirt with a bee design.
A person wearing a beekeeping suit walks through a garden towards a beehive, carrying a smoker to calm bees before inspection.
C inspects a honeycomb frame covered in bees, wearing a beekeeping suit and protective gear.

C places a wooden frame into a beehive box, then adjusts a beekeeping hat over their head.
C adjusts the beekeeping hat, ensuring it fits properly over their head.
C adjusts a smoker tool, releasing smoke from its cone-shaped nozzle.

A beekeeper wearing protective gear uses a smoker to calm bees near a beehive. Smoke rises from the smoker's nozzle, indicating its use to deter bees. The beekeeper holds the smoker steadily, directing it towards the hive entrance.
